short_description: Run three independent glue-clamp timers and find which assembly is ready to release.
description: Run three independent glue-clamp timers and find which assembly is ready to release. Select clamp A, B or C with the wheel. Click edits its duration in minutes, then click again to browse. Start runs an idle timer or acknowledges a completed timer. Hold Start cancels only the selected clamp. Other timers continue using absolute deadlines across app restarts.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
